DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML).

The MRI confirms multifocal demyelinating lesions without enhancement, and since your CBC and metabolic panels are normal, we must determine if this is due to HIV, other immunosuppressive therapies, or hematologic malignancy.
